correctness.rationale: Over Q, the natural reduced Świątkowski quasi-isomorphism realizes \(H_2\) at weight four exactly as the kernel of two multiplication maps from U⊗U⊗Sym²(E), with no incoming differential because there are exactly two poles. Splitting E=Qt⊕U, the t² kernel is zero, tU kernel is Λ³U and the Sym²U kernels are Schur (2,1,1) and (2,2) by Pieri decomposition and nonzero multiplication on target summands. Degree-one Koszul sign produces pole parity; edge stabilization from weight three exhausts pole-even. Independent exact modular matrix and pole eigenspace checks for k=3..6 all returned VERIFY_OK, serving only as finite checks, not characteristic-zero proof.

value.rationale: The natural four-particle degree-two representation of the k-arm banana/theta graph separates the entire stabilized three-particle contribution from a genuinely new pole-odd Schur functor for every k≥3. It gives a complete rational symmetry decomposition for an infinite family and distinguishes relations and sign behavior invisible from rank, planar-generator, or three-particle theta-class statements. At k=3 it detects the first degree-two class and its pole-reversal sign. The invariant is geometrically motivated by graph-braid second-homology generators and endpoint interchange, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
